title: DOW-UAP-PR20, Unresolved UAP Report, Kuwait, May 2022
doc_notes: This document is a Department of War report regarding a UAP sighting in Iraq submitted by USCENTCOM to AARO, featuring a redacted sensor image.

incidents.summary: U.S. Central Command reported a UAP observed in Iraq, documented via a still image from a military system.
incidents.quote: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
